name: requirements management team
normative-structure: The Requirements Management Team receives witnessed needs, pressures, constraints, conflicts, and changes as evidence-bearing demand; for major requirements and changes it decides whether the firm takes them up, refuses them, or sends strategic matters to the integrated portfolio body. Its output is a jurisdiction-bound requirement or stated disposition, never a project task, code patch, or claim that work completed. A requirement retains its originating demand, stakeholders, jurisdiction, success and falsification conditions, causal dependencies, and unresolved ambiguity. Requirements Analysis traces an accepted requirement into analysis and distribution; work, market, and office processes realize it; evidence must return to the originating demand before closure can be read. Thus task or artifact completion is not discharge, and a missing return path remains a typed residual. The office practices guanli kexin development: lawful public records with zero-distance traceability to the end user rather than an internal proxy.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the requirements management team (需求管理团队, RMT) decides major requirements and requirement changes, and is composed of the product management head with market, R&D, manufacturing, service, finance, and quality representation — requirements are decided cross-functionally rather than by whoever received them

huidu-guanli/ipd: decision authority over requirements is tiered — routine to the requirements analysis team (需求分析团队), major and changed to this office, strategic to the integrated portfolio management team at a decision checkpoint; one flat intake office is the shape this structure exists to replace
huidu-guanli/ipd: offering requirements (产品包需求, OR) run 收集 → 分析 → 分发 → 实现 → 验证 → 闭环; RMT holds major/change decision, RAT holds analysis/distribution, and delivery is not closure
rendanheyi: 零距离 and the chain-group contract require need → requirement → work/office/market → artifact/act → evidence → originating need; a non-returning distinction is residual rather than success

architecture-decision-records (Nygard, 2011): context/decision/consequences as the minimal rulable shape for a choice put to someone who was not in the room it was made in — the same shape this office already owes a requirement's raiser, extended to a decision generally
cmmi-dar: alternatives evaluated against what the situation forces, and a recommended solution named rather than assumed — a decision naming one option is an announcement, not a decision
ieee-iso-iec-42010: rationale capture — the alternatives considered are carried alongside the one chosen, not discarded once a ruling lands
ietf: last-call before canonization — a decision moves proposed, to a final call for objection, to decided, rather than being canon the moment someone states it

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule

huidu-guanli/ipd: offering requirements run 收集 (collection) ahead of 分析 (analysis) — an idea enters the record before it can be graded; question-driven development treats the idea as the substrate unit of not-yet-knowing, canonically sourced from user desires and bug reports; MAPE-K's Monitor phase reads the idea pool as its buffer over shared Knowledge, and raising-an-idea's --open readout is that Monitor's derivation, computed at read time and never stored
unrealized: nothing in the tree distinguishes a routine requirement from a major one, so the tier boundary beneath this office is a claim rather than a computation — the rungs exist, and what sends a requirement up one is still a judgement call

this office's cross-functional composition — market, R&D, manufacturing, service, finance, and quality representation — does not exist as seated offices, so it is presently its own product-management head deciding alone, which is the shape the composition exists to prevent
